property_summary: For any admissible input, calling c.version() returns the string "1.0.0" (the declared major.minor.patch version); the mutant returns "1.0.1", so the returned version string does not start with the correct prefix '1.0.0', violating the rule for every input.
change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.0.1".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.1"; }
